ValidationRule.description: The Fields are required in Stage 2
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( NOT(ISPICKVAL(Customer_Type__c, "Existing customer")), OR( ISPICKVAL(StageName, "2 - Define & Evaluate Requirements"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "3 - Solution Review & Approval"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "4 - Commercial Negotiation"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "5 - Order Commitment"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Closed Lost") ), OR( $RecordType.DeveloperName = "Excelitas_Sales_Opportunity" ), OR( ISBLANK(Full_Production_Annual_Value__c)
) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please complete all value fields before advancing to Stage 2 on an Excelitas Sales Opportunity. - Full Production Annual Value - Revenue Forecast Year 1 - Revenue Forecast Year 2 - Revenue Forecast Year 3
